projectmemo.problem: Course projects, research training, and competitions generate a constant stream of paper notes, experiment results, error logs, meeting conclusions, and material requirements — all scattered across chats, docs, and personal notes. The older a project gets, the harder it becomes to answer: why was this decided? Was that risk handled? What's next? And near every deadline, the digging and re-assembling starts over. Generic AI Q&A generates in one shot but holds no stable project memory and can't say which historical record a suggestion came from.
projectmemo.problemZh: 大学生在课程设计、科研训练和学科竞赛里持续产生论文笔记、实验结果、代码报错、会议结论和材料要求。这些碎片散落在聊天记录、文档和个人笔记里，项目越久越难回答：当时为什么这样决定？风险处理了吗？下一步做什么？临近截止又要重新翻找、整理、拼装材料。通用 AI 问答擅长一次性生成，却没有稳定的项目记忆，也说不清建议来自哪条历史记录。
projectmemo.role: Team leader & product owner. I set the product boundary and the agent interaction principle ("proactive but never overreaching"), designed the fragment-to-card structuring pipeline and the intervention loop, built the Next.js/Prisma data model, and enforced the "must demo offline" engineering constraint.
projectmemo.roleZh: 队长 & 负责人：定产品边界与 Agent 交互原则（「主动但不越权」），设计碎片结构化管线与主动介入闭环，搭建 Next.js/Prisma 数据模型，并执行「离线必须可演示」的工程约束。
projectmemo.system: Three layers. The application layer owns project isolation, input validation, rule triggers, tool whitelists, and database transactions; LLMs appear only as structuring/generation nodes and never write data directly. Incoming fragments are structured into knowledge cards (summary, keywords, tasks, importance, next step), linked to history with original-text references. A context event engine runs five rule-based triggers after project access or data changes (deadlines, unresolved risks, stagnation, experiment gaps, material gaps); hits become evidence-backed interventions, which the user confirms into action items whose completion writes back as reflection cards.
projectmemo.systemZh: 系统分三层。应用层负责项目隔离、输入校验、规则触发、工具白名单与数据库事务；LLM 只作为结构化/生成节点，从不直接写数据。碎片进入后先被结构化为知识卡片（摘要、关键词、任务、重要性、下一步），与历史卡片关联并保留原文引用。上下文事件引擎在项目访问或数据变更后运行五类规则触发器（截止日期、风险、停滞、实验缺口、材料缺口），命中后生成带证据的主动介入，用户确认后落地为行动项，完成结果自动回写为复盘卡片。

decisions.alt: Let the LLM drive memory writes and reminders directly — the common agent shape.
decisions.altZh: 让 LLM 直接驱动记忆写入与主动提醒（常见的 Agent 形态）。
decisions.choice: LLMs are structuring/generation nodes only; writes, validation, tool whitelists and transactions all live in the application layer.
decisions.choiceZh: LLM 只做结构化/生成节点；写入、校验、工具白名单与事务全部收在应用层。
decisions.why: Model timeouts, malformed JSON, or missing keys can never corrupt data or block a demo — the pipeline falls back to a deterministic mock, and every intervention stays traceable to its evidence cards.
decisions.whyZh: 模型超时、非法 JSON、无密钥都不能破坏数据或打断演示——管线回退确定性 mock，且每条介入都能溯源到证据卡片。

decisions.alt: Pure embedding retrieval for memory linking.
decisions.altZh: 用纯向量检索做记忆关联。
decisions.choice: A VectorStore abstraction with keyword-intersection scoring, keeping the top-3 related cards with original-text references.
decisions.choiceZh: VectorStore 抽象 + 关键词交集计分，保留 top-3 相关卡片与原文引用。
decisions.why: Student fragments hinge on exact tokens — course codes, dates, error messages. Keyword intersection is explainable and traceable, and the abstraction keeps the door open for hybrid retrieval later.
decisions.whyZh: 学生碎片里课程名、日期、报错信息这类精确 token 至关重要；关键词交集可解释、可追溯，抽象层也为后续混合检索留了接口。

decisions.alt: Let the agent act on risks directly — more "autonomous".
decisions.altZh: 让 Agent 发现风险后直接执行——看起来更「自动」。
decisions.choice: Every intervention carries its trigger reason and cited evidence; the user picks accept / later / dismiss, and only acceptance creates an action item.
decisions.choiceZh: 每条介入必须带触发原因与引用证据；用户在 接受 / 稍后 / 忽略 中三选一，只有接受才会生成行动项。
decisions.why: "Proactive but never overreaching": writes require confirmation, and completion receipts write back as reflection cards — an explainable closed loop instead of a black box.
decisions.whyZh: 「主动但不越权」：写操作必须确认；完成结果回写为复盘卡——是可解释的闭环，而不是黑箱。

decisions.altZh: 操作系统级的后台推送提醒。
decisions.choice: A context event engine that runs triggers on project access and data changes.
decisions.choiceZh: 上下文事件引擎：在项目访问与数据变更后运行触发器。
decisions.why: For a single-user demo, claiming OS-level push would overstate the system. Event-driven triggering covers the real usage scenes — and keeps the claim honest.
decisions.whyZh: 单用户 Demo 阶段宣称 OS 级推送就是夸大；事件驱动已覆盖真实使用场景，且口径诚实。

failures: An early flowchart included "assignee" fields for actions — but a single-user demo has no real roles, and the field stayed empty. We cut it from the current-capability list entirely; it survives only as a marked extension point for team collaboration.

The first reminder implementation rendered in-page and vanished on refresh. Interventions are now persisted (AgentIntervention) with per-project dedup keys, so "later / dismiss" states survive reloads and never nag twice.

Demo data initially risked blending into effect metrics. Simulated scenarios now carry an explicit mock flag and are excluded from real metrics — demo honesty is enforced by schema, not by discipline.
Early versions relied on live model calls, which meant any demo could break on network or keys. The pipeline was rebuilt mock-first: the OpenAI-compatible provider is optional, never a prerequisite.
failuresZh: 早期流程图画进了「负责人分配」，但单用户 Demo 没有真实角色，字段落了空——最终从当前能力清单中删掉，只保留为团队协作扩展位。
第一版提醒只在页面内渲染，刷新即丢。现在介入被持久化（AgentIntervention）并带项目内去重键，「稍后 / 忽略」状态可保存，也不会重复打扰。
演示数据一度可能混进效果指标。现在模拟情境带显式 mock 标记并从真实指标中剔除——演示诚实靠 schema 保证，不靠自觉。
早期版本依赖在线模型，任何一次演示都可能被网络或密钥打断。管线重构为 mock-first：OpenAI-compatible 是可选 Provider，不是前提。
projectmemo.status: Semifinalist at C4-AI 2026. The web demo runs fully offline: fragment structuring, knowledge linking, action board, proactive reminders, citation-backed copilot, and six deliverable types (weekly report, entry doc, defense slides, README, résumé blurb, next-week plan) are all implemented. Xiaoyi Workflow integration is interface-reserved only; voice, images, and background push are on the roadmap.
projectmemo.statusZh: C4-AI 2026 已晋级复赛。Web Demo 完全离线可演示：碎片结构化、知识关联、行动板、主动提醒、带引用的记忆副驾驶与六类成果生成（周报、作品说明、答辩 PPT、README、简历描述、行动计划）均已实现。小艺 Workflow 仅预留接口；语音、图片与后台提醒在后续路线。

math-model-harness.problem: In math-modeling competitions, using AI is practically unavoidable — but "where did this result come from, where was AI involved, and can the paper be reproduced" usually can't be answered. This harness turns a competition project into a manifest-driven pipeline: artifact DAGs, verification gates, and auditable AI-usage disclosure, so evidence comes before conclusions.
math-model-harness.problemZh: 数学建模竞赛里几乎不可能不用 AI，但「结果怎么来的、AI 用在哪、论文能不能复现」往往说不清。这个 Harness 把一场比赛变成由清单驱动的流水线：工件 DAG、验证门禁、可审计的 AI 使用披露——让证据先于结论。
math-model-harness.role: Solo developer. I designed the v2 data model and CLI state machine, wrote the AI-ledger and gate rules, and built the deterministic projections and run receipts.
math-model-harness.roleZh: 独立开发：设计 v2 数据模型与 CLI 状态机，制定 AI 台账与门禁规则，实现确定性投影与运行回执。
math-model-harness.system: harness.py is the single entry point: init / status / prepare / check drive a project through milestones (M1 → … → S1). init writes only four minimal files (competition_profile, run_manifest, artifact_dag, run_index); the project stays parked at M1 until the problem statement, data boundary, model contract, verification plan, and human confirmation are all real. Every `run` captures a receipt — stdout, stderr, and exit code. `prepare` generates projection documents (MODELING_PLAN, PAPER_OUTLINE, AI_USAGE_LEDGER, …), each listing the SHA-256 of its source files.
math-model-harness.systemZh: harness.py 是唯一入口：init / status / prepare / check 驱动项目按里程碑（M1 → … → S1）推进。init 只写四个最小文件（competition_profile / run_manifest / artifact_dag / run_index），项目停在 M1，直到题面、数据边界、模型合同、验证计划与人工确认全部落实。每次 run 都捕获回执——stdout、stderr 与退出码。prepare 生成投影文档（MODELING_PLAN、PAPER_OUTLINE、AI_USAGE_LEDGER 等），每份都列出源文件的 SHA-256。

decisions.alt: Generate a full set of template files at init so the project "looks complete".
decisions.altZh: init 生成全套模板文件，让项目「看起来很完整」。
decisions.choice: v2 init writes only four minimal files; everything else is generated per-milestone by prepare.
decisions.choiceZh: v2 的 init 只写四个最小文件；其余全部由 prepare 按里程碑生成。
decisions.why: Dozens of empty JSON files create an illusion of progress. Files must come from real inputs — the project stays parked at M1 until the problem and verification plan actually exist.
decisions.whyZh: 几十个空 JSON 制造完成度的幻觉。文件必须来自真实输入——项目停在 M1，直到题面与验证计划真实存在。

decisions.alt: Infer "no AI used" from an empty usage log.
decisions.altZh: 从「AI 使用记录为空」推断「未使用 AI」。
decisions.choice: AI-usage state starts as unknown; confirm-none requires a human, a name, and a reason; unverified records block formal gates.
decisions.choiceZh: AI 使用状态从 unknown 起步；confirm-none 必须由人给出署名与理由；未核验记录直接阻断正式 Gate。
decisions.why: An empty array is not evidence of non-use. Compliance statements can only be made by a person — the machine doesn't answer for you.
decisions.whyZh: 空数组不等于没用过。合规声明只能由人作出——机器不代答。

decisions.alt: Let people hand-edit the projected Markdown to "pass" checks.
decisions.altZh: 允许手改投影 Markdown 来「通过」检查。
decisions.choice: Projections list their source-file SHA-256; hand edits never pass a gate — change the source, re-project.
decisions.choiceZh: 投影文档列出源文件 SHA-256；手改不会让 Gate 通过——改源头，重新投影。
decisions.why: A projection must be a deterministic function of the project state. Otherwise documents drift from reality and the audit is worthless.
decisions.whyZh: 投影必须是项目状态的确定性函数；否则文档与事实漂移，审计失去意义。

decisions.alt: Have prepare S1 produce a "final submission".
decisions.altZh: 让 prepare S1 直接产出「最终提交版」。
decisions.choice: S1 only creates a mutable staging area and a disclosure draft; the harness never claims "submission ready".
decisions.choiceZh: S1 只创建可变的 staging 与 disclosure 草稿；Harness 永不自动宣称「可提交」。
decisions.why: Uploading to the competition portal is a human's button to press. The harness doesn't submit homework for you.
decisions.whyZh: 上传比赛门户的按钮永远由人来按。Harness 不替你交作业。

failures: v1's init sprawled dozens of empty JSON files — it looked like engineering but was all placeholders. v2 cut it back to four minimal files, and everything empty became milestone-gated generation.

The AI ledger was first treated as a plain log field. Then it became clear that "AI was not used" is itself a claim that needs evidence — hence the unknown initial state, human confirm-none, and gates that stay blocked until verification.

An early temptation was to treat "tests pass" as proof of capability. The constraint is now written into the tool itself: the harness doesn't guess problems, fake results, or count tests as award-worthy evidence — it checks the evidence chain, not luck.
failuresZh: v1 的 init 会铺开几十个空 JSON 文件——看起来工程浩大，实际全是占位符。v2 砍回四个最小文件，所有空模板改为按里程碑生成。
AI 台账最初只是普通日志字段。后来意识到「未使用 AI」本身就是一个需要证据的声明——于是有了 unknown 初始态、人工 confirm-none，以及核验完成前保持阻断的正式 Gate。
早期有过把「测试通过」当能力证明的冲动。这条约束现在写进了工具本身：Harness 不猜题、不伪造结果、不把测试当奖项证据——它检查的是证据链，不是运气。
math-model-harness.status: Active open-source project (since Aug 2026). Currently supports competition profiles (CUMCM etc.), milestone gates, the AI ledger synced to AI_USAGE_LEDGER.md, run receipts, and projection documents. A distributable wheel bundling schemas/references/assets is future platform work.
math-model-harness.statusZh: 持续开发的开源项目（2026.8 起）。当前支持比赛画像（CUMCM 等）、里程碑门禁、同步到 AI_USAGE_LEDGER.md 的 AI 台账、运行回执与投影文档。打包 schemas/references/assets 的发布型 wheel 属于后续平台化工作。

luojia-math-tutor.problem: Generic LLM tutoring has two failure modes: the urge to hand over full answers (killing the student's chance to think), and hallucinated logic — one wrong intermediate step in a calculus derivation collapses everything after it. Luojia Tutor separates "teaching" from "verification" and rebuilds Q&A as a verifiable, adaptive learning agent.
luojia-math-tutor.problemZh: 通用大模型辅导数学有两个死穴：倾向于直接交出完整答案（剥夺学生思考机会），以及逻辑幻觉——微积分推导中间错一步，后面全部崩塌。珞珈数智助教把「教学」与「验证」职责剥离，把问答重构成可验证的自适应学习智能体。
luojia-math-tutor.role: Team leader & principal investigator (WHU Volcano Cup entry). I defined the teaching/verification separation principle, designed the LangGraph scheduling and latency budgets, and co-built the math knowledge base and evaluation set.
luojia-math-tutor.roleZh: 队长 & 负责人（火山杯作品）：定「教学/验证分离」原则，设计 LangGraph 调度与延迟预算，参与数学知识库与评测数据集建设。
luojia-math-tutor.system: FastAPI + LangGraph backend, Next.js frontend. Each request hits a local fast-path router: the opening targets <150ms; session history, BKT mastery, BM25 retrieval, and on-demand SymPy checks share a 350ms fast-context deadline. A verification gate then routes: ordinary teaching goes to a single streaming Teacher call; complex proofs or locally-unverifiable steps escalate to a Verifier LLM. Normal requests hold llm_call_count == 1; high-risk verification stays ≤ 2.
luojia-math-tutor.systemZh: FastAPI + LangGraph 后端、Next.js 前端。每个请求先经本地快路径路由：Opening 目标 <150ms；会话历史、BKT 掌握度、BM25 检索与按需 SymPy 校验共享 350ms 快速上下文截止时间。随后验证门禁分流：普通教学走一次 Teacher 流式调用；复杂证明或本地无法判定的步骤升级 Verifier LLM。普通请求 llm_call_count == 1，高风险验证 ≤ 2。

decisions.alt: A classic serial pipeline: Planner → Policy → Verifier → Teacher → Examiner on every request.
decisions.altZh: 经典串行流水线：Planner → Policy → Verifier → Teacher → Examiner 每轮全跑。
decisions.choice: LangGraph schedules on demand by risk and confidence; ordinary explanations take a single streaming Teacher call.
decisions.choiceZh: LangGraph 按风险与置信度按需调度；普通讲解只走一次 Teacher 流式调用。
decisions.why: Fixed serialization made every simple question queue through multiple models — latency data killed it. The fast path keeps role separation while pinning normal requests to one call.
decisions.whyZh: 固定串行让每个简单问题都要排完整条模型队列——延迟数据否定了它。快路径保留角色分工，同时把普通请求压到一次调用。

decisions.alt: Free-form chat where the AI just solves everything.
decisions.altZh: 自由对话，AI 直接给完整解答。
decisions.choice: Teacher guides Socratically; student steps are checked by SymPy first; only open proofs escalate to the Verifier.
decisions.choiceZh: Teacher 负责启发式引导；学生步骤先经 SymPy 校验；只有开放证明才升级 Verifier。
decisions.why: Autoregressive models are built to please — handing over answers is their default. Symbolic checks are deterministic, and BKT mastery steers the guidance as weaknesses emerge.
decisions.whyZh: 自回归模型的默认倾向是讨好式给答案。符号校验是确定性的，BKT 掌握度让引导随薄弱点动态调整。

decisions.alt: Expose the model's chain-of-thought to look more "transparent".
decisions.altZh: 展示模型思维链，显得更「透明」。
decisions.choice: SSE emits only four public process summaries ([PLAN] / [RAG] / [VERIFY] / [OUTPUT]); raw reasoning_content is never sent or stored.
decisions.choiceZh: SSE 只发四类公开过程摘要（[PLAN] / [RAG] / [VERIFY] / [OUTPUT]）；原始 reasoning_content 不发送、不保存。
decisions.why: Process state helps learners; raw chains of thought are unstable, uncontrollable, and break refresh recovery. Summaries persist, so reloading a session still shows what happened.
decisions.whyZh: 过程状态对学习者有用；原始思维链不稳定、不可控，也无法支持刷新恢复。摘要持久化后，重新进入会话仍能看到发生了什么。

failures: The first version ran every role serially on every request — even a simple concept question queued the whole pipeline. The latency measurements rejected that design and produced the fast-path router and hard call-count budgets.
An internal review rejected the show-the-chain-of-thought approach: uncontrollable content and no recovery after refresh. It became the four public summary events plus persisted summaries.
failuresZh: 第一版让所有角色每轮固定串行——连简单概念题都要排完整条流水线。延迟实测否定了这个设计，才有了快路径路由与硬性调用上限。
直接展示思维链的方案在内部评审被否：内容不可控、刷新后无法恢复。改为四类公开摘要事件 + 摘要持久化。
luojia-math-tutor.status: First Prize, WHU 1st "Volcano Cup" Agent Innovation Competition. Supports text/image input, OCR, RAG retrieval, SymPy verification, and BKT mastery tracking; latency budgets and call-count caps are enforced engineering constraints.
luojia-math-tutor.statusZh: 武汉大学首届「火山杯」智能体创新大赛一等奖。支持文本/图片输入、OCR、RAG 检索、SymPy 校验与 BKT 掌握度追踪；延迟预算与调用上限是写进工程的硬约束。

docparse.problem: An undergraduate innovation program on multimodal document understanding and structural parsing. On complex layouts and noisy documents, parsing models behave unstably; batch jobs that crash mid-way used to restart from zero; and quality was hard to track continuously.
docparse.problemZh: 大创项目：多模态文档理解与结构化解析。复杂版式与噪声文档下解析模型表现不稳定；批量任务中途失败往往要从头重跑；效果也难以持续度量。
docparse.role: Core team member: GPU inference environments and dependency-conflict triage, data cleaning and synthetic-augmentation pipelines, and the evaluation loop.
docparse.roleZh: 核心队员：负责 GPU 推理环境与依赖冲突排查、数据清洗与合成增强管道、评测闭环搭建。
docparse.system: An end-to-end parsing system with batch processing, checkpointing, and exception retry. On the data side, cleaning and synthetic-augmentation pipelines improve robustness on complex layouts; on the evaluation side, an automated multi-metric loop (mAP / F1 / BLEU / TEDS) closes the iteration cycle.
docparse.systemZh: 端到端解析系统：批量处理 + 断点续跑 + 异常重试。数据侧以清洗与合成增强管道提升复杂版式下的鲁棒性；评测侧以 mAP / F1 / BLEU / TEDS 多指标自动化闭环支撑持续迭代。

decisions.alt: One long batch process; any failure fails the whole batch.
decisions.altZh: 单进程跑批，任何失败导致整批作废。
decisions.choice: Batch processing with checkpoints and exception retry.
decisions.choiceZh: 批处理 + checkpoint 断点续跑 + 异常重试。
decisions.why: For long jobs, interruption cost dominates. Checkpoints turn failures from disasters into recoverable events.
decisions.whyZh: 长任务的中断代价最高。断点续跑把失败从灾难变成可恢复事件。

decisions.alt: Ad-hoc debugging of CUDA and dependency conflicts on every machine.
decisions.altZh: 每台机器上临时排查 CUDA 与依赖冲突。
decisions.choice: Environment setup and conflict triage codified into a repeatable configuration.
decisions.choiceZh: 把环境配置与冲突排查流程固化成可复现的配置。
decisions.why: GPU environments were the root cause of most failures and slow runs. Codifying them made deployments reproducible and cut the failure rate.
decisions.whyZh: GPU 环境是多数失败与慢跑的根因。固化之后部署可复现，失败率明显下降。

failures: Early on, dependency conflicts kept breaking runs and triage ate days. Freezing the environment into configuration finally stabilized efficiency and the failure rate.
Tracking only the headline metric hid regressions on specific layout classes. Adding the automated multi-metric loop made iteration sustainable.
failuresZh: 早期依赖冲突频繁中断运行，排查动辄数天。把环境固化成配置后，效率与失败率才真正稳定。
只看总体指标会掩盖特定版式类别上的退化。补上多指标自动化评测后，迭代才可持续。
docparse.status: Ongoing undergraduate innovation program (since Sep 2025). No public repository.
docparse.statusZh: 大创项目进行中（2025.9 起）。无公开仓库。
